note: SDC Display renders fields, view modes, and field groups through Single Directory Components. Config is stored on entity_view_display: per-view-mode/per-field third_party_settings.sdc_display = {enabled, component:{machine_name}, mappings:{static,dynamic}} and a field-group formatter with id 'sdc_display' (view context). Component pickers are populated via tags sdc_display:field_formatter and sdc_display:view_mode (component_tags.yml). Depends on cl_editorial + sdc_tags. Medium cases read a known mapping/group from live display config; hard cases enable a whole-view-mode component mapping (verify checks enabled + component.machine_name) and add an sdc_display field group (verify checks a group with format_type sdc_display). Grounded in real components on this site (e.g. olivero:teaser). All state is display config (no field storage), so cases are verifiable on the shared site.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal sdc_display module, how do you make a single directory component available in the field or view-mode configuration pickers? Name the tags involved.
evals.expected_output: Tag the component with sdc_display:field_formatter (to offer it for fields/field groups) or sdc_display:view_mode (to offer it for whole view modes) in its *.component.yml; these tags are declared in sdc_display.component_tags.yml via cl_editorial's sdc_tags.

evals.prompt: Does sdc_display provide a Field Group formatter? What is its id and which display context does it support?
evals.expected_output: Yes: the field_group FieldGroupFormatter with id 'sdc_display' (label 'Single Directory Component'), supported context 'view' only. It renders a group's fields through a component.

evals.prompt: Where does sdc_display store the mapping between a view mode (or field) and its single directory component, and what keys does that config carry?
evals.expected_output: On the entity_view_display config in third_party_settings.sdc_display: enabled, component.machine_name, and mappings (static/dynamic props and slots). Depends on cl_editorial + sdc_tags.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type's default view display is configured with sdc_display to render through a single directory component. Inspect the live configuration and give the component machine name it uses.
evals.expected_output: core.entity_view_display.node.article.default third_party_settings.sdc_display has enabled: true and component.machine_name: olivero:teaser.

evals.prompt: The Article default view display on this site has a field group named group_sdcd_known. Inspect the live configuration and state which Field Group formatter (format type) it uses.
evals.expected_output: group_sdcd_known uses format_type: sdc_display (the Single Directory Component field-group formatter), with format_settings.component.machine_name = olivero:teaser.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use sdc_display to make the Article content type's default view display render through the single directory component 'olivero:teaser'. Enable the SDC Display view-mode mapping and set the component. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: core.entity_view_display.node.article.default third_party_settings.sdc_display has enabled = true and component.machine_name = olivero:teaser.

evals.prompt: On my Article pages I want to render a group of fields using one of my design-system components. Using SDC Display, add a field group on the Article content display that renders through a single directory component.
evals.expected_output: The node.article default entity_view_display has a field group in third_party_settings.field_group with format_type = sdc_display (component set in format_settings.component.machine_name).
